route_and_target_classification.outcome: Official FAQ names exactly 14 Biosciences PhD Home Programs and says the only same-year multi-program exception permits two Biosciences choices in one application. The application asks for primary and one alternative Home Program; only 12 Home Programs are owned by the Medicine evidence dossier. Biology and Biophysics remain H&S-owned. The shared application does not change degree/program ownership.

eligibility_prerequisites_and_exceptions.outcome: Common eligibility is a U.S. bachelor degree or recognized international equivalent before enrollment. Four named programs (Biomedical Data Science, Biophysics, Molecular and Cellular Physiology, Structural Biology) have course-background requirements; their exact requirements must remain option-specific. No minimum GPA is stated on the reviewed page. English test waiver categories are explicitly enumerated.

tests_scores_editions_validity_and_waive.outcome: Current GRE table says GRE General is not considered across all 14; GRE Subject is optional only for Biophysics (Mathematics or Physics), not considered for the other 13. TOEFL/IELTS minimums: TOEFL 90 before 2026-01-21, 4.5 on/after that date; IELTS 7; two-year validity and earliest accepted date 2024-09-01. Incoming English Placement Test cutoffs 109/5.5/8 are post-admission placement conditions, not admission minima. GRE official reports expire after five years; current page accepts tests from Sep 1, 2021 onward and permits self-reported scores for initial review. TOEFL/IELTS have two-year validity and explicit accepted-date floors; required official scores come directly from ETS or IELTS e-delivery.

application_materials_interviews_portfol.outcome: Application requires three recommendations (up to four), a two-page single-spaced statement, unofficial transcripts for every postsecondary institution, CV, research experience and Home Program/faculty selections. Up to six experiences are listed; unrequested extra publications/theses are not considered. Selected applicants interview March 3-6, 2027 at Stanford expense; virtual interviews may be available for highly qualified international applicants unable to travel.

cycle_deadlines_windows_timezone.outcome: One annual Autumn entry. Autumn 2027-28 application and all recommendations due Dec 1, 2026 at 11:59:59 p.m. Pacific Time; late materials are not guaranteed review. Invitations mid-January through mid-February; offers generally mid-March; accept by April 15, 2027. KHS is a separate earlier application due Oct 6, 2026 at 1 p.m. Pacific.

fees_and_cost_components.outcome: Application fee is USD 125, nonrefundable, payable on submission; waiver eligibility and handling are referred to central Graduate Admissions. Degree tuition and student-budget living components are not fully reconciled in this review; no total of attendance is inferred from the fellowship offer. The $125 nonrefundable application fee is paid at submission; waiver processing is through central Graduate Admissions. Total attendance cost was not verified.
fees_and_cost_components.open_reason: The program FAQ points to the central Stanford Student Budget for cost-of-attendance estimates; need direct current budget/tuitions page check for annual-period components and which are covered by award.

KHS covers first three years and Home Program covers remaining years.
funding_eligibility_amount_duration_rene.open_reason: 2027-28 award amount/benefits and any individual offer terms are not yet published as of 2026-10-03.
